source.title: Eversong Diamond — Warcraft Wiki (alternative source statement)

notes: NEW unverified alternative-source contradiction, not a prospecting study. The wiki Eversong Diamond page says this item can be looted from Alchemy's School of Gems (item 245648), but the wiki School of Gems contents list names eight non-diamond gem types and does NOT list Eversong Diamond. Wowhead School of Gems commenter obsidiangel asks if anyone ever received a diamond, without asserting one. Independent firsthand Wowhead commenter Ianto reports container outputs 2 Flawless Sanguine Garnet, 1 Flawless Amani Lapis, 2 Flawless Harandar Peridot, 1 Flawless Tenebrous Amethyst and 5 Amani Lapis. Those exact quantities are container output, NOT prospecting outputs; Ianto states no completed-open denominator, no zero-inclusive distribution, no individual material item links/ranks, no profession skill/patch and no confirmed Eversong Diamond hit. Do not put this sample into ore 237362/237363 or 237359 denominators. Source pages: https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/School_of_Gems ; https://www.wowhead.com/item=245648/school-of-gems ; https://www.wowdb.com/spells/1230893-school-of-gems. Master would need an OpenContainer evidence method/schema if this alternate yield source is to be modeled; do not modify estimator from this record.
lookingFor: Original observed School of Gems 245648 -> Eversong Diamond 242608/242712 occurrence and whether this non-prospecting source may contaminate ore baselines
